item.title: Catfood Level Monitor for HomeAssitant
item.description:
The Problem

My wife and I take care of 40+ rescued cats at home. With this, comes a few things we need to keep an eye on – cat food and litter. We hire staff to help us with the day-to-day tasks in our small shelter, and they do let us know when supplies are getting low, but I thought it would be nice to have a way to automate the process and give us better operational awareness.
